column1: # ROUTER YAML DEBT (#router-r5, ROUTER_PROGRAM §2.5, §3.5, §10 R5) — every shipped category
# file line (configs/vnncomp24|25|26/*.yaml) that sets the route key of a ROUTABLE capability
# (a registry row in crates/ny-cli/src/router/registry.rs with routing data).
# Columns:  state <TAB> category file <TAB> typed key path as written <TAB> value <TAB> capability
#   debt      the capability is SEALED (SR.seal: S7 + S8 done, envelope recorded): the router
#             routes it per instance, name-blind, and this file line decides instead — PIN DEBT.
#             The count MAY ONLY FALL (BASELINE_DEBT in `router_yaml_debt_matches_manifest`):
#             retire the line, never raise the baseline.
#   unsealed  the capability is not sealed yet: the router cannot route it, so the file line is
#             today's only delivery (a measurement or a user-directed arming). Listed so the line
#             becomes visible debt the moment the capability is sealed.
